description: PH6 severity level definitions for governance findings. Defines workflow behavior, certification implications, and merge policy per severity. Referenced by governance_drift_scan.py and ai_preflight_check.py.

CRITICAL.workflow_behavior: Fail immediately. No further checks required.
CRITICAL.merge_implication: BLOCK — must not merge until all CRITICAL findings are resolved
CRITICAL.certification_implication: STOP-SHIP — PH6-CERT run is invalid. Certification cannot proceed.
examples: Forbidden term used in authoritative context (e.g. PSEUDO, SoSo, adaptive in Lane-1 path)
SHA-256 used as canonical hash authority (sha256_status violation)
Forbidden JSON field present in schema-locked file

HIGH.merge_implication: BLOCK — must not merge until all HIGH findings are resolved or formally waived
HIGH.certification_implication: CERTIFICATION HOLD — PH6-CERT run is suspended until findings are cleared or a governance waiver packet is issued
examples: Governance manifest file missing or unreadable
Schema lock registry references a file that does not exist
Lane authority map entry malformed or missing required fields
Forbidden term found in a borderline context requiring human adjudication

WARN.workflow_behavior: Scan completes and exits 0. Warning is surfaced in report output.
WARN.merge_implication: ALLOW with review — WARN findings must be acknowledged before merge in a certification context; advisory-only in development sessions
WARN.certification_implication: CERTIFICATION ADVISORY — recorded in the cert run report. Does not block cert, but must be reviewed and annotated before a SEALED cert is issued.
examples: Forbidden term found only in definitional or prohibition context (scanner correctly exempts, surfaces as WARN for audit trail)
DRAFT file contains terminology that is flagged in canon but not yet promoted

INFO.workflow_behavior: Scan completes and exits 0. Finding is recorded in JSON report only.
INFO.certification_implication: INFORMATIONAL — logged in cert run report for provenance. No review obligation.
examples: STOP-SHIP gate is open (OI-01, OI-03) — noted for traceability, does not block AI session work
Governance manifest version is older than latest schema version
Schema count or entry count differs from last known baseline

exit_code_map.2: FAIL — HIGH findings present, no CRITICAL

SEALED_cert_requires: exit_code == 0 on both ai_preflight_check.py and governance_drift_scan.py
All WARN findings reviewed and annotated in cert run report
All INFO findings recorded in cert run report
No open STOP-SHIP gates (OI-01, OI-03) unless formally waived
cert_run_invalidated_by: Any HIGH finding without an active governance waiver packet
